summary: Validate data-impact ownership and lossless snapshot migration contracts

delivery.outcome: Classify private component state without integration false positives; retain independently authorized lossless snapshot migration and all ownership, scope and review gates.
nonGoals: No Taskand repository or deployment writes.
No global budget increase, secret-scan exception, direct merge, history deletion or authorization inferred from repository prose.
No claim that source publication deploys an adopter or a CI profile.

architecture.decision: Bind migration to exact source/base/tree and inventory plus an independently pinned external grant. Preserve the original source as a merge parent. Validate ordinary repairs separately and preserve every other governance gate. Fresh protected base and single ticket/branch binding prevent reuse after integration.
interfaceChanges: Optional snapshot migration contract and protected authorization input.
Typed data impact records; legacy descriptions remain integration-owned.
architecture.rollback: Use a reviewed successor package; preserve source ancestry and all original refs. No adopted copy is hand-edited.

validation.evidence: Real Git fixtures preserve source ancestry and exact imported bytes, with intent in the first migration commit.
Reject foreign repository, changed source/tree/base/inventory, missing grant, lost history and consumed grant; count new repairs under unchanged budgets.
Managed package, schemas, runbook and ordinary-project protections remain valid; independent review precedes adoption.
